title: Irish Nourishing Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish stew made with nourishing ingredients and potatoes. This stew is perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: irish stew meat
ingredients.notes: beef or lamb, cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the beef broth and water, whisking constantly.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Add the potatoes and cook for an additional 30 minutes, or until they are tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
